snippet.title: Chico's Rebound Release Announcement Trailer!
snippet.description:
Chico's Rebound is out now on Steam, itch.io, and Nintendo Switch!

Break blocks, grab powerups, solve puzzles, and beat bosses! When a mysterious tower appears in the forest, Chico the Chipmunk and his new friend Beeatrice decide to go exploring. Master skill-based block breaking challenges, as well as environmental puzzles and exploration!

Download today!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3139060/Chicos_Rebound/

https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/chicos-rebound-switch/
